hook: Pulse-based deepfake detectors do not detect a pulse. They pick up high-frequency video artifacts.
hook_turn: They pick up high-frequency video artifacts.

readout.label: AUC of chrominance traces, talking-face fakes

summary: Tests on Celeb-DF++ and FaceForensics++ show simple color traces beat a dedicated pulse extractor, yet work equally well on backgrounds and sit above the heart-rate band. Detectors trained on one dataset label over 99% of real videos from the other as fake, and the Celeb-DF splits leak identities between training and test. The findings cover two datasets and the detector families tested.
title: Pulse or Provenance? What rPPG-Based Deepfake Detectors Learn
